//: Self-registration off: users are created on first Google login (identity brokering).
//token-lifespans: Short access token; app renews via refresh token (AppAuth). The client-side entitlement cache adds an offline grace window on top.

realm.name: paid
realm.description: User has an active Just Talk entitlement. Granted manually now; by a payment webhook later. Absence = locked app.

//default-roles: New users get only default-roles-justtalk (which does NOT include 'paid'), so everyone starts locked until 'paid' is granted.

clients.name: Just Talk (macOS + iOS)
clients.description: Public native client. Authorization Code + PKCE via AppAuth. No client secret.
